scope: steady-state cached UInt16 read/write; coherent primary, random/partial/churn contrasts

dotnetlab.role: MCP compatibility discovery and hypothesis records; external .NET 11 rig for timing and JIT diagnostics

catalogue.M1: One reused inline-cache object: accessor allocation 40 -> 552 bytes. Zero measured steady-state allocation. Churn allocation adds one word-array reference per leaf.
catalogue.M2: No temporary buffers in the access operation; stack storage does not apply.
catalogue.M3: H6/H17: optimized caller retains array guards; unchecked alternatives measured without repeatable benefit.
catalogue.M4: H6/H17: GC-tracked byref experiments; no raw pointers or pinning; rejected.
catalogue.M5: H8/H9/H13/H18/H24: retain safe activity-word alias and inline leaf cache; reject cached-origin/saturation metadata; remove internal-node retention.
catalogue.M6: H3/H5/H10/H24: retain 64-slot leaf lookup; canonical tree probing handles genuine misses; internal-node caches removed.
catalogue.M7: No copies or bulk output in a scalar accessor; no caller reordering or bulk-API substitution.
catalogue.C1: H13: dependent origin loads; caller accumulation/unrolling retained identically across managed/native comparisons.
catalogue.C2: H4/H11/H12/H14/H16/H18: containment predicates, saturation branch, hit/miss layout.
catalogue.C3: Scalar operation with single logical value; batching/SIMD would change the measured public caller contract.
catalogue.C4: Coordinate and bit offsets already use shifts/masks; no division or manual bit scan to replace.
catalogue.C5: No neighborhood or stencil in this accessor.
catalogue.S1: H11/H18: avoid idempotent saturated-word updates, with conservative activity invalidation.
catalogue.S2: H2/H3/H5/H10: repeated dictionary traversal, node cache, direct-mapped leaf cache.
catalogue.S3: Tree mappings are mutable; frozen replacement would require rebuild/invalidation outside this scope.
catalogue.S4: Original lazy topology-version invalidation clears all secondary entries before reuse; full origin checks reject collisions.
catalogue.S5: Arbitrary unmanaged values and independent activity prohibit substituting compressed uniform values for general writes.
catalogue.R1: No reflection/delegate dispatch in access; separate value-only reads in H1.
catalogue.R2: H1/H2/H12/H16: selective hot inlining/cold splitting; 12-byte Coord remains by-value for API compatibility and identical callers.
catalogue.R3: Runtime/PGO settings frozen across arms; no per-access feature flags.
catalogue.T1: One accessor per thread; no shared mutable cache or parallel timed kernel.
catalogue.T2: Original one-accessor-per-thread/exclusive tree mutation protocol retained. Registry experiments H15/H20 were superseded.
catalogue.T3: Final code introduces no registry or locks. Callback/weak-table/weak-list alternatives were rejected after churn measurements.
catalogue.T4: Single-thread scalar accessor objective; parallelism or bulk batching would change useful work. All host benchmarks serialized.

inference: Descriptive paired process launches, not independent individual-latency observations. No p-values, p99, PMU, application-speed, or full-runtime-qualification claims. No favorable-sample exclusions.
